posts.title: Nostalgic Internet Projects – Spelunkr TV and Relisten
posts.description: I’ve had fun this morning exploring Spelunkr TV , an online tv channel directory that reruns old shows/movies streamed from the internet archives. Here’s a link to their directory of channels . My favorite so far is channel 96 , which just plays old employee training videos. posts.title: Optimist
posts.description: Feeling good about today! My day started by slipping and falling down the stairs, coffee in hand. My coffee splashed all over the carpet and walls as I bounced halfway down the staircase on my bum. Fortunately, the coffee had already cooled and I feel okay other than a slight headache. Finished reading: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy by Douglas Adams 📚 Quick and funny, this was a nice leisurely listen. I appreciated the British narrator, who perfectly punctuated the deadpan, sarcastic, and self-deprecating British humor.
